orchestrator.name: lead-architect
orchestrator.description: Analyzes requirements, inspects architecture, decomposes tasks, coordinates parallel/sequential execution, prevents conflicts, and integrates completed work.

specialists.name: frontend-specialist
specialists.description: Implements React 19 UI, Tailwind CSS, Zustand stores, Electron renderer components, ensuring anti-boxiness, borderless design, accessibility, and high rendering performance.

specialists.name: glass-material-specialist
specialists.description: Authority on advanced glass materials, transparency, refraction, SVG displacement filters, chromatic aberration, blur, highlights, layered surfaces, and background composition.

specialists.name: backend-specialist
specialists.description: Implements Node.js Electron main process services, IPC channels, SQLite persistence (better-sqlite3, Drizzle ORM), PTY processes, and filesystem operations.

specialists.name: git-specialist
specialists.description: Manages Git integration, repository operations, worktrees, branches, diff analysis, and commit coordination without destructive actions.

specialists.name: security-specialist
specialists.description: Audits code and architecture for security vulnerabilities, Electron process isolation, IPC channel integrity, and path traversal prevention.

specialists.name: qa-specialist
specialists.description: Validates code, executes unit and integration tests (Vitest), verifies TypeScript types, checks build stability, and performs independent screenshot-based visual QA, 6-dimension scoring, and regression checks.

specialists.name: performance-specialist
specialists.description: Profiles and optimizes CPU, memory, React rendering performance, SQLite query efficiency, and IPC message throughput with measurable evidence.

specialists.name: code-quality-specialist
specialists.description: Audits and refactors codebase for SOLID principles, TypeScript clean architecture, DRY principles, Ponytail simplicity ladder, and anti-pattern elimination.

specialists.name: documentation-specialist
specialists.description: Maintains and updates architectural specifications, API guides, user guides, changelogs, and codebase documentation accurately reflecting verified code.

specialists.name: research-specialist
specialists.description: Investigates technical libraries, APIs, architectural patterns, and feasibility questions with fact-checked evidence before code adoption.
